entries.title: I Peter 5:1
segments: Now to you who are presbyters I make this appeal; for I am myself a presbyter, and was a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory about to be revealed.

entries.title: I Peter 5:2
segments: Be shepherds to your flock of God; take charge of them willingly, and not through compulsion; not for filthy lucre, but with a willing mind;

entries.title: I Peter 5:3
segments: not by way of lording it over your heritage, but by becoming examples to the flock.

entries.title: I Peter 5:4
segments: Then, when the Chief Shepherd shall appear, you too will receive the fadeless wreath of glory.

entries.title: I Peter 5:5
segments: You younger men must submit to the presbyters; and all of you must put on the garment of humility and serve one another, for God resists the haughty, But gives grace to the humble.

entries.title: I Peter 5:6
segments: So humble yourselves under God's mighty hand, so that he may exalt you in due time.

entries.title: I Peter 5:7
segments: Cast all your care upon him, for he ever cares for you.

entries.title: I Peter 5:8
segments: Be temperate, be vigilant; because your enemy, the devil, is prowling about like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

entries.title: I Peter 5:9
segments: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, knowing well that the same afflictions are being accomplished in your brothers that are in the world.

entries.title: I Peter 5:10
segments: But the God of all grace, who has called us by Christ Jesus to share his eternal glory, will, after you have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

entries.title: I Peter 5:11
segments: His is the dominion forever and ever; Amen.

entries.title: I Peter 5:12
segments: By Sylvanus, a faithful brother of yours, as I suppose, I have written you briefly, to comfort you, and to testify that this is the true grace of God. In this stand fast.

entries.title: I Peter 5:13
segments: Your sister church in Babylon, elect with you, sends you salutations, and so does Marcus, my son.

entries.title: I Peter 5:14
segments: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ Jesus.
